Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
My group wants to do an extended event over 6 weeks, playing 1 game each
week.

All that is easy enough to figure out, and with a small group your allowed
to switch deck each round so no issues there as far as managing control of
deck lists between rounds.

My question concerns just how to deal with the player that drops a round.
Say they play rounds 1, 2 and 3, miss round 4, play five miss round 6.

And likewise what should be done when you played 2 rounds and a new player
wishes to join in?

Raille
oh yea 6+F baby!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Same as when the event is run with all rounds back-to-back, you
handle drops as best you can (reseating to meet the V:EKN
stipulations), and accept adds between rounds if and when you
like.
